query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM users u
            JOIN employees e
              ON e.id = $2
             AND e.company_id = $3
             AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
            WHERE u.id = $1
              AND u.is_active = TRUE
              AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND (
                  u.employee_id = $2
                  OR (
                      e.email IS NOT NULL
                      AND btrim(e.email) <> ''
                      AND lower(btrim(e.email)) = lower(btrim(u.email))
                  )
              )
        ) AS "owned!"
